target_hypothesis: The V0.13 cross-job response variation is associated with a stable recorded GitHub-hosted hardware/software environment fingerprint; alternatively, if variation persists among jobs with the same recorded fingerprint, the recorded host fingerprint is insufficient and a deeper numerical runtime-state audit is required.
object: Across-independent-job pairwise relative spread of the signed centered beta response (plus-minus)/(2h) on the exact V0.13/V0.14 diagnostic cells, grouped by a prospectively fixed normalized host hardware/software fingerprint. Only PURE_PAIR solver construction is used because V0.14 established exact within-run repeat determinism in both profiles and V0.15 tests cross-host variation rather than interleaving.

pre_registered_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: If an anchor cross-job spread reaches 1e-5, requested-node binding exceeds 1e-12, any required lane is missing, a response is non-finite, a frozen identity/hash fails, or fingerprint integrity/ephemeral-field exclusion fails, classify CROSS_HOST_FINGERPRINT_AUDIT_INCONCLUSIVE and authorize no scientific promotion.
pre_registered_decision.NOT_REPRODUCED: If all invariants and anchors pass and every REPLAY_FAILURE cell has cross-job max pairwise spread <1e-5 across the eight jobs for its grid, classify V013_CROSS_JOB_NONDETERMINISM_NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_V015. Authorize only a separately frozen separated-interpolation confirmation audit; do not promote V0.12 directly.
pre_registered_decision.SAME_FINGERPRINT_VARIATION: If all invariants and anchors pass, at least one REPLAY_FAILURE cell has cross-job spread >=1e-5, and any combined-fingerprint group containing at least two jobs has within-group spread >=1e-5 on a REPLAY_FAILURE cell, classify RECORDED_HOST_FINGERPRINT_INSUFFICIENT_CROSS_JOB_VARIATION_PERSISTS. Authorize only a separately frozen numerical runtime-state fingerprint audit.
pre_registered_decision.FINGERPRINT_STRATIFIED: If all invariants and anchors pass, cross-job variation >=1e-5 is reproduced, no repeated combined-fingerprint group has within-group failure-cell spread >=1e-5, and at least two distinct repeated combined-fingerprint groups on the same grid have group-mean separation >=1e-5 for a REPLAY_FAILURE cell, classify HOST_ENVIRONMENT_FINGERPRINT_STRATIFICATION_SUPPORTED. Authorize only a separately frozen host-factor isolation audit.
pre_registered_decision.UNDERPOWERED_OR_MIXED: If all invariants and anchors pass and cross-job variation >=1e-5 is reproduced but the frozen repeated-fingerprint evidence satisfies neither SAME_FINGERPRINT_VARIATION nor FINGERPRINT_STRATIFIED, classify HOST_ENVIRONMENT_FINGERPRINT_AUDIT_UNDERPOWERED_OR_MIXED. Authorize only a separately frozen expanded host-fingerprint replication audit.

interpretation_ceiling: V0.15 may localize or fail to localize the already-established cross-job numerical reproducibility defect with respect to the prospectively fixed recorded host fingerprint. It cannot validate full Layer-B, covariance, whitening, nuisance treatment, relation-null, Wm_S3, global traversal, a dark-sector signal, or any physical inference.
